purpose: Whole-document suitability screen of the XVS report for evaluation planning. This artifact is not a model input packet, dataset, reference Gold, or model result.

methods: downloaded PDF SHA-256 and page-count inspection
text extraction across all 40 PDF pages
visual inspection of PDF page 1, Appendix D index page 28, and tree pages 29-36

source_document.title: Updated External Vision System (XVS) No Droop Hazard Analysis Study
source_document.author: R. D. Dangaran

rights_review.pdf_cover_notice_observed: The report states that Limited Exclusive Rights expired, while use, duplication, and disclosure remain subject to NASA Langley STI process and any other restrictive notices.
rights_review.pdf_footer_notice_observed: EXPIRED Limited Exclusive Rights Data NAS1-20220

document_family_and_overlap.family_policy: Keep the 1998 XVS No Droop predecessor, this 1999 update, and directly related XVS candidate-concept material together as one source cluster; do not partition figures or events across splits.
document_family_and_overlap.predecessor_named_in_report: External Vision System (XVS) No Droop Hazard Analysis Study Report dated 1998-09-30; its complete matching artifact was not located or screened in this pass.

related_official_record.title: External Vision System Description of Candidate Concept
related_official_record.relation: The screened report identifies a Concept Definition Document as its system-description source; this official XVS candidate-concept report is a related family lead and its PDF was not opened.

overlap_limitations: The 1998 predecessor and related CR #29-C19 PDF were not content-compared.
An exact identifier/title/cluster scan is not proof of semantic independence.
The current XVS PDF and its fault-tree pages have now been opened, so this source family is no longer blind to the project team.

body_failure_condition_table.table: Table 3.2-3 XVS Display System Functional Hazard Assessment
body_failure_condition_table.finding: The table supplies system-level failure-condition wording, effects, flight phases, classifications, and probability limits; it does not give the complete lower-level causal decomposition shown in Appendix D.

fault_tree_appendix.gate_source: Gate types are represented by diagram symbols; the report body does not provide text evidence authorizing the complete gate assignments or lower-level branch structure.

other_sections.finding: The report contains system architecture, failure-condition assessment, dependence diagrams, and quantitative reliability tables. These are not equivalent to prose that explicitly states all tree branches and gate logic.

evaluation_suitability.diagram_reference_use: Potentially useful only for a separately defined diagram-reference or source-sufficiency development fixture; do not expose Appendix D to a text-only model input.
evaluation_suitability.abstention_control_use: Potential development-only negative control: body text identifies high-level failure conditions but does not support reconstructing the full Appendix D tree.

next_safe_step: Find a different complete source using metadata-only screening, keep its PDF/tree pages unopened until source-family boundaries and the frozen evaluation configuration are confirmed, then perform the whole-document rights/content/overlap screen before allocating any packets.
